scope: Read-only AWS IAM, S3, CloudTrail, and AWS Config control-plane audit of the Canadian raw-archive bucket.

remediation.change: Create separate least-privilege uploader and narrowly scoped break-glass retention-administration roles; independently review their trust and permission policies.
Choose a Canadian log destination and retention period, then enable S3 object-level CloudTrail data events and a documented review process.
Approve retention and storage-cost policy before adding only non-bypassing lifecycle and incomplete-multipart-cleanup rules.
Approve a legal-hold SOP, authorized role, audit review and a reversible exercise that does not change compliance retention.
Approve a Canadian recovery design and destination, then exercise recovery while preserving primary version retention; do not enable replication before residency and cost review.
